text: For Antigonus was not punished for Demetrius, nor, of the old heroes, Phyleus for Augeas, or Nestor for Neleus, for though their sires were bad they were good, but those whose nature liked and approved the vices of their ancestors, these justice punished, taking vengeance on their similarity in viciousness.
author: Plutarch
locator: On Those Who Are Punished by the Deity Late
